origin.description: Parse a URI reference into its parts.
origin.details: Uses the RFC 3986 regular expression. Missing parts are empty strings. The columns are scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment.
origin.value: A data frame with five columns.

translation.description: Parse a URI reference into its parts.
translation.details: The same regular expression. Each reference is a dict with those five keys. An empty input is an empty list.
